title: Speech gap probe (measured noise floor)
what_it_does: Measures a clip's own noise floor, speech onset/decay and every sub-threshold gap from the audio, so cuts land in real silence. Its author's point: transcript word boundaries are not cut points, since ASR can report a gap where the voice is continuous.
when_to_use: Checking cut points before removing a pause or a filler word.
why: Apache-2.0 with NOTICE (keep it); small TypeScript file that works on any video; makes transcript-based cutters safer.
